DESCRIPTION:
Install required development tools

USAGE:
    cosmos install [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help           Prints help information                                
    -y, --auto           Automatically install without prompting                
        --setup <DIR>    Bundle all tools into DIR for offline installer        
                         packaging                                              
        --tools          Only install system tools (QEMU, clang, lld, xorriso)  
                         from the Cosmos tools release                          
        --packages       Only install Cosmos dotnet tools, templates, and VS    
                         Code extension

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Build a Cosmos kernel project

USAGE:
    cosmos build [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
                     DEFAULT                                                    
    -h, --help                  Prints help information                         
    -p, --project               Path to the kernel project (default: current    
                                directory)                                      
    -a, --arch                  Target architecture (x64, arm64). If not        
                                specified, builds for detected/default arch     
    -c, --config     Debug      Build configuration (Debug, Release)            
        --all                   Build for all supported architectures           
    -v, --verbose               Show detailed build output                      
        --json                  Output results as JSON (for IDE integration)

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Boot a built kernel ISO in QEMU

USAGE:
    cosmos run [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
                              DEFAULT                                           
    -h, --help                           Prints help information                
    -p, --project                        Path to the kernel project (default:   
                                         current directory). Used to locate the 
                                         ISO when --iso is not given            
    -a, --arch                x64        Target architecture (x64, arm64).      
                                         Default: x64                           
        --iso                            Explicit path to the ISO to boot. If   
                                         omitted, looks in output-<arch>/ for a 
                                         *.iso                                  
    -m, --memory              512        Memory in MB. Default: 512             
        --cpu <MODEL>                    QEMU CPU model, e.g. host, max, qemu64,
                                         cortex-a72. Omit for auto: on x64,     
                                         'host' when KVM is available, else     
                                         'max'. 'host' needs KVM and falls back 
                                         to 'max' without it                    
        --headless                       Run without a display window           
                                         (serial-only)                          
        --debug                          Wait for a GDB connection on port 1234 
                                         (-s -S)                                
        --disk <SPEC>                    Attach a disk image the kernel can use 
                                         at boot. Format: 'path' or 'path,kind' 
                                         where kind is ahci (default) or nvme.  
                                         Repeatable                             
        --nic <M
[truncated]
